newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia army seizes guns from Aceh villages.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia army seizes guns from Aceh villages.

text.p: Indonesian troops have seized 37 foreign-made weapons, including 22 rifles from a village witchdoctor, in an operation against separatists in the province of Aceh, Antara news agency said on Thursday.

It said the weapons seizures in three locations in the north Sumatran province of Aceh, brought the total number of guns found since May 1996 to 120 along with more than 8,000 rounds of ammunition. Last month, 45 rifles were seized.

The report said soldiers in the Samalanga sub-district of the North Aceh regency, about 1,600 km (1,000 miles) northwest of Jakarta, found 19 Russian-designed AK-47s, three U.S.-made M-16s and 1,500 bullets hidden under the bed of a village witchdoctor.
Antara said the man, identified only as Afn D, and his wife were taken into custody by security officials. Gun ownership in Indonesia is tightly controlled.
In the second seizure, at another village in Samalanga on Wednesday, soldiers found three AR-15 rifles, and in adjacent Pidie regency seized another 10 AK-47s, one M-16 and a grenade launcher.
A separatist, mainly Islamic rebellion in Aceh peaked in 1990 and has now largely subsided, but a few skirmishes between the rebels and the military are still reported.
Indonesia's military has said the recent weapons seizures were a strong indication the rebels were planning a "comeback".
